title.zh: 不再成立需要开始成立

statement.zh: 成立者每步被列出时，不再成立的复现需要开始成立的复现；反之不然。
statement.en: Where what holds is listed at each step, ceasing to be recurring needs coming to be recurring; the converse fails.

laws.zh: 一个规定每步的成立者被不重复地列出、且每步可判定时，在任意晚的步有成员不再成立，就在任意晚的步有成员开始成立。
laws.en: Where the members of which a determination holds are listed at each step, each once, and the determination is decided at each step, members ceasing to hold at arbitrarily late steps need members coming to hold at arbitrarily late steps.

laws.zh: 证明经过普查的平衡：不再成立复现时，从任一步 N 起其间不再成立的累加而超过 N 时的列表，而终点的列表连同其间不再成立的恰是 N 时的列表连同其间开始成立的，所以其间有开始成立。
laws.en: The proof goes through the census balance: with ceasing to be recurring, the ceasings from any step N on accumulate past the list at N, while the list at the end with what ceased between is the list at N with what came between, so something comes to be between.

laws.zh: 普查就是活动的列出：在普查之下，止息复现需要生起复现；读于世界：有普查、活动可判定的世界中，止息复现就有生起复现。
laws.en: A census is the listing of activity: under a census, ceasing recurring needs arising recurring; read of worlds, in a world with a census whose activity is decided, ceasing recurs only where arising recurs.

laws.zh: 读于水平：所立者的普查之下，不再作为条件而在的复现需要开始作为条件而在的复现。读于依存：每步的依存被列出时，消解复现需要形成复现。
laws.en: Read of standing: under a census of what stands, ceasing to stand recurring needs coming to stand recurring. Read of dependence: where the dependences of each step are listed, dissolving recurring needs forming recurring.

laws.zh: 反之不然：accretion 有普查，生起复现而从不止息；attrition 止息复现而没有任何生起，所以由这一规律，它没有普查。
laws.en: Not conversely: accretion has a census, and arising recurs in it while nothing ever ceases; attrition keeps ceasing while nothing arises, so by this law it has no census.

laws.zh: 只要在任意晚的步有列表覆盖成立者，不再成立的复现就需要开始成立的复现；普查是覆盖每一步的情形，所以世界与水平的读法是 laws-of-one-step 这一规律的推论。
laws.en: Ceasing recurring needs coming to be recurring wherever some list covers what holds at arbitrarily late steps; a census is the case of covering every step, so the world and standing readings are corollaries of this law of laws-of-one-step.

laws.zh: 不用判定时，列表覆盖第 N 步、此后没有开始成立，不再成立就不复现。
laws.en: With no decision, where a list covers step N and nothing comes to be after it, ceasing does not recur.

hypotheses.zh: 列出：每步成立者被不重复地列出，所以每步只有有限多个成立；成员总共可以无限多。普查与所立者的普查是它读于活动与水平。
hypotheses.en: Listing: the members holding at each step are listed, each once, so finitely many hold at each step; there may be infinitely many members in all. The census and the census of what stands are this read of activity and of standing.

hypotheses.zh: 可判定：在纯核心中找出开始成立者要判定该规定；读于活动是活动可判定，读于水平自动成立（自然数的比较可判定）。这是表示的逻辑承诺，经典地总是成立。
hypotheses.en: Decidability: finding what comes to be in the pure core needs the determination decided; read of activity this is decided activity, read of standing it holds automatically (comparison of natural numbers is decidable). It is a logical commitment of the representation and classically always holds.

hypotheses.zh: census_one_way 是关于两个具体世界的陈述，不加前提。
hypotheses.en: census_one_way is a statement about two particular worlds, with no premise.

does_not_show.zh: 本规律是计数，不是机制：不说哪个成员开始成立，也不说开始成立与不再成立有因果关联。
does_not_show.en: The law is a count, not a mechanism: it says neither which member comes to be nor that coming to be and ceasing to be are causally linked.

does_not_show.zh: 复现是在任意晚的步出现，不给出频率。
does_not_show.en: Recurring means occurring at arbitrarily late steps and gives no frequency.

does_not_show.zh: 开始成立复现一般不需要不再成立复现；列表有界时需要（bounded-census-keeps-pace）。
does_not_show.en: Coming to be recurring does not in general need ceasing to be recurring; it does where the list is bounded (bounded-census-keeps-pace).

detail.zh: accretion：有普查，生起复现而从不止息，所以逆命题不成立；attrition：止息复现而没有生起，没有普查，所以普查不可少。
detail.en: accretion: a census, arising recurring, nothing ever ceasing, so the converse fails; attrition: ceasing recurring with nothing arising and no census, so the census is needed.

next_delta.zh: 带频率或比例的版本；非离散步的读法。
next_delta.en: Versions with frequencies or proportions; readings not across discrete steps.

correspondence.zh: 有限家族的规律（coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace：coming_recurs_iff、Web.unceasing_iff）中开始成立复现恰当不再成立复现；关系项无限多时两者分离（Accretion、Attrition）。这里分离只在一个方向上需要无限：每步只有有限多个成立时，不再成立复现仍需要开始成立复现，反之不然。这一规律对每步被列出的任何规定成立，活动与水平是它的两种读法，如那一记录把同一种变化读于活动、依存与水平。作者的读法（AI 论证）：在每步有限的展开中，没有只灭不生的不息；可以有只生不灭的不息，只要成员总共无限多。英文名称 arising/ceasing 经 Ren 确认（2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names；中文 生起／止息 是 AI 的译名）；这一读法不是 Ren 提议中的“生成的”“退化的”（Ren 写道“generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧”，以“吧”预设二者不重叠，所以这一读法不是其所指；二者读作对能形成者的扩大与缩小，DELEGATED-CHOICES D2）。
correspondence.en: In the law of a finite family (coming-and-ceasing-keep-pace: coming_recurs_iff, Web.unceasing_iff), coming to be recurs exactly when ceasing to be does; with infinitely many relata the two separate (Accretion, Attrition). This result shows that the separation needs infinity in one direction only: with finitely many holding at each step, recurring ceasing to be still needs recurring coming to be, but not conversely. The law holds of any determination whose holders are listed at each step; activity and standing are two readings of it, as that record reads one change of activity, dependence and standing. The author's reading (an AI argument): in an unfolding finite at each step there is no endless ceasing without arising; there can be endless arising without ceasing, provided the members are infinitely many in all. Arising and ceasing are names Ren confirmed (2026-10-09-arising-ceasing-names); this reading is not the proposal's generative and degenerative (Ren wrote ‘generative和degenerate虽然都在一个becoming model上，但是他们不overlap吧’, a tag question presuming that they do not overlap, so this reading is not what is meant; they read as widening and narrowing what can form, DELEGATED-CHOICES D2).

detail.zh: 复用普查的平衡读于复现（Listed.coming_iff_excess、Listed.over_stretch），普查定律由它推出。
detail.en: Reuses the census balance read of recurrence (Listed.coming_iff_excess, Listed.over_stretch); the census law follows from it.

output.zh: 开始成立复现，恰当起点的列表长于某个后来的列表连同其间不再成立的。
output.en: Coming to be recurs exactly when the list at the start is longer than some later list with what ceased between.

input.zh: 不再成立复现时，其间不再成立的累加而超过起点的列表，所以开始成立复现。
input.en: With ceasing to be recurring, what ceases accumulates past the list at the start, so coming to be recurs.

detail.zh: 复用止息（Web.Ceases）、Accretion 与 Attrition 两个见证，以及在任意晚的步为正的量的累加（recurring_accumulates）。
detail.en: Reuses ceasing (Web.Ceases), the witnesses Accretion and Attrition, and the accumulation of a quantity positive at arbitrarily late steps (recurring_accumulates).

output.zh: 有限家族中生起复现恰当止息复现；关系项无限多时两者分离。
output.en: In a finite family arising recurs exactly when ceasing does; with infinitely many relata they separate.

input.zh: 每步有限时，止息复现仍需要生起复现。
input.en: Finite at each step, recurring ceasing still needs recurring arising.

detail.zh: 复用普查（Web.Census）。P30 之前另复用不重复列表的长度比较（length_le_of_sub）与列表上的判定（search）。
detail.en: Reuses the census (Web.Census). Before P30 it also reused the length comparison of lists without repetition (length_le_of_sub) and search over a list (search).

output.zh: 普查与列表工具；普查无界地增长使生成不息。
output.en: The census and list tools; a census growing without bound makes generation unceasing.

input.zh: 普查之下，止息复现需要生起复现。
input.en: Under a census, recurring ceasing needs recurring arising.

detail.en: Reuses the census of a world (World.Counted).

output.zh: 普查是世界的前提，有限世界有普查。
output.en: A census is a premise of worlds, and a finite world has one.

input.zh: 有普查的世界中，止息复现就有生起复现。
input.en: In a world with a census, recurring ceasing comes with recurring arising.

detail.zh: 复用世界、生起复现与止息复现、accretion 与 attrition 及其分离（separate）。
detail.en: Reuses worlds, arising and ceasing recurring, accretion and attrition and their separation (separate).

output.zh: 关系项无限多时，生起复现与止息复现可以各自出现。
output.en: With infinitely many relata, arising and ceasing can each recur without the other.

input.zh: attrition 没有普查由本规律推出。
input.en: That attrition has no census follows from this law.

detail.zh: 证明改经一步的规律：World.arising_of_ceasing 与 Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing 经 coming_of_ceasing_covered 证明。
detail.en: The proofs now go through the laws of one step: World.arising_of_ceasing and Web.StandingCensus.coming_of_ceasing are proved through coming_of_ceasing_covered.

output.zh: 只要在任意晚的步有列表覆盖成立者，不再成立的复现就需要开始成立的复现；不用判定时，覆盖第 N 步且此后没有开始成立，不再成立就不复现。
output.en: Ceasing recurring needs coming to be recurring wherever some list covers what holds at arbitrarily late steps; with no decision, where a list covers step N and nothing comes to be after it, ceasing does not recur.

input.zh: 普查覆盖每一步（Listed.covered），所以普查定律的世界与水平读法是推论。
input.en: A census covers every step (Listed.covered), so the world and standing readings of the census law are corollaries.

conditions.zh: 覆盖成立者的列表；确切计数要求判定。
conditions.en: A list covering what holds; the exact count needs a decision.

detail.zh: 逆命题：列表有界时，开始成立复现也需要不再成立复现，两者同步。
detail.en: The converse: where the list is bounded, recurring coming to be also needs recurring ceasing to be, and the two recur together.

detail.zh: 本规律由它推出（P30）；比率形式：任一段步上，不再成立比开始成立多出的不超过起点的列表。
detail.en: This law follows from it (P30); the form with rates: over any stretch, ceasings exceed comings by at most the list at the start.

detail.zh: 停息定理用本规律使止息停止，所以只要求生起者体现。
detail.en: The rest theorem uses this law to stop ceasing, so only whatever arises needs to be embodied.

detail.zh: 计划 P26：带普查前提的活动规律；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Plan P26: a law of activity with a census as its premise; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.
